follow_up_questions.title: Change in angina pattern
follow_up_questions.question: Has the pain been coming on more often, lasting longer or with less activity than before, and have you had any episodes at rest or that wake you at night?
follow_up_questions.why: A crescendo or rest-pain pattern defines unstable angina and would call for same-day emergency evaluation rather than outpatient cardiology next week.

follow_up_questions.title: Heart failure symptoms with edema
follow_up_questions.question: Do you get short of breath lying flat or wake up at night breathless, and have you noticed weight gain or worsening leg swelling?
follow_up_questions.why: New ankle edema with a murmur and suspected ischemia warrants excluding heart failure before attributing it to blood pressure.
